source_quotes: review all do a full review of call sites based on all new work any expansions needed or not
overlap_check: Draft 12 (gates that cannot judge await) is the behaviour of a gate; this is the review of its coverage. Draft 45 holds the policy. Related to 43. New.

payload.name: Review Every Call Site Against the Gate, Not Only the Obvious Route
payload.description: When a gate is added or changed, every place content leaves the process or a call executes is inventoried and judged by its real destination. A clearance covers one hop, an unreachable gate sends nothing, and a held call waits.

principles.name: A gate is only as good as its coverage
principles.description: The first bypass is rarely the route everyone knows; it is the spawned binary, the sidecar or the remote pipeline.

heuristics.condition: a component has its own provider keys
heuristics.action: treat it as a bypass and bring it under the host or disable it when hosted

heuristics.condition: the gate is not installed yet
heuristics.action: judge with the compiled defaults, never allow

decision_rules.name: Inventory every site
decision_rules.condition: a gate is added or changed
decision_rules.outcome: list every place content leaves or a call runs: host seams, spawned binaries, tool HTTP and SSE calls, remote pipelines, agent steps, peer serving, search bridges, probes, script tools and submodules

requires.name: code_callgraph
requires.purpose: find call sites in code when building the inventory

decision_rules.name: Judge the real destination
decision_rules.outcome: classify by where the content actually goes, per pipeline, per tool and per URL host, not by the model endpoint configured for the call

decision_rules.name: A clearance covers one hop
decision_rules.condition: a cleared mark travels with a call
decision_rules.outcome: do not let it cover a different destination; each hop checks again

decision_rules.name: Spawned code asks the host
decision_rules.condition: a separate process sends content out
decision_rules.outcome: have it ask the host before every request; when the host cannot be reached the request is not sent

decision_rules.name: Unaudited is never local
decision_rules.condition: code is tool-created, self-registered or imported
decision_rules.outcome: label it unaudited and judge it as an unlisted destination, never as local

decision_rules.name: Held means pause
decision_rules.condition: the gate cannot judge or waits for the operator
decision_rules.outcome: hold with backoff and a durable awaiting item and never allow; a held call returns an error callers may retry

decision_rules.name: Document the constants
decision_rules.condition: a call carries no user content
decision_rules.outcome: record why, such as a constant probe, so the inventory is complete

decision_rules.name: Re-run on expansion
decision_rules.condition: a new entry kind, pipeline, tool or route is added
decision_rules.outcome: re-run the inventory and update the route registry; run the jurisdiction third-party suite first in the first walk after a deploy
